defaultTeam.interpretation: default-team is a profile/default association and cannot represent the exact roster team for every member of a roster

associatedClubId.interpretation: strong profile-level club association on this control roster; still insufficient to prove a specific team+tournament membership

federativeCard.interpretation: club association is consistent in this control; federative category uses a different representation/vocabulary from team.ageCategory and must not be joined by literal text

height.normalizationRule: preserve raw string; replace comma decimal separator if present; parse numeric; only derive centimeters after validating 1 <= value < 3; derived centimeters = value * 100

scopeCaveat: Counts and type/scale semantics are confirmed on the complete Ferro 1843/775 control roster. Preserve provenance and validate when generalizing to other competitions or future app versions.
